_what: the second tier of the codebook: entries the compile table needed and neither an anchored nor a theory-derived entry of data/codebook/v0.1.json covers. Same schema, empty anchors, status theory-derived, and `provenance` says which cell asked for it. The pilot codes anchored entries only; one of these is anchored the day a record shows an instance, and the version has to move for that.

entries.definition: A choice is settled by taking whatever is already available in the moment, and the thing that was arranged is dropped without being argued about.
entries.trigger: a choice where one of the options is physically available now and the other has to be waited for or travelled to
entries.suppressor: somebody else's arrangement is what would be dropped, and they are present to see it dropped
occasions: a plan for later exists and something is available now
a shop, a train or a seat is in front of her and the arranged one is not
somebody asks which of two, one of them present
the arranged thing comes round and is not taken
entries.function: gets the day moving on what is in reach, at the cost of whatever was arranged for later.
variation: the arranged place is swapped for the one they are standing outside
the answer is the thing on the table rather than the thing named
the plan is not cancelled and simply does not happen
entries.includes: The taking of the available option is the instance, whether or not the dropped arrangement is ever mentioned.

excludes.rule: changing the plan is announced with its reason at the time; this one substitutes without announcing anything.
refusing the either-or gives both options their due; this one settles it by proximity and gives the dropped one nothing.

near_misses.why: the act there ends a feeling that has run to its limit; here nothing is at a limit and the option is taken because it is there.
that one is about the getting being the whole of the wanting; here the thing taken is used, and what is lost is the arrangement.

tunes.dial: what the day's plan is allowed to be overwritten by
tunes.note: the plan is the day's one truth, so a rate here is a rate of the ledger being rewritten by the moment.
